thread:
sanjay: FYI incoming vendor advisory about an HSM firmware integrity edge-case that may break attestation checks for some BYOK flows (CVE-2026-ABCD). Needs swift triage: RBAC, audit logs, KMS fallback. Who can take lead?
kelly: Is this public yet or limited disclosure? link?
sanjay: Vendor sent embargoed advisory and repro. Customer stumbled on attestation mismatch post-update. Sharing details in DM.
maria: Security action items:
1) disable auto-updates on affected clusters
2) enable DEBUG audit for Wrap/Unwrap/Attestation
3) snapshot attestation blobs + export
4) prepare rewrap playbook to vetted HSMs
5) contact Legal/Compliance for BYOK notification requirements
raj: RBAC mitigation: temporarily remove ExportKey from any principal that also has WrapKey. Enforce JIT for hsm-admin. Create a short deny policy for cross-tenant exports.
elaine: Can we quickly enumerate principals with wrap+export in all regions? I can run the IAM binding scan.
kelly: I'll run a logs+config correlation query. Example wrap event query:
```
resource.type=\"cloud_hsm_key\" protoPayload.methodName=\"WrapKey\"
```
I'll run against prod-eu cluster now.
ops-bot: ALERT: 4 wrap/unwrap attempts by single principal in hsm-prod-eu within 10s. Incident created: #6150000015 :rotating_light:
maria: We need attestation chains from the HSMs. If attestation fails, trigger rewrap and rotate CMKs. For BYOK customers, we must offer forensics + rewrap and inform Legal.
sanjay: Drafting customer notification. Keep it concise.
maria: Suggested message: "We've observed a potential integrity anomaly in a third-party HSM firmware affecting attestation. We're investigating. No evidence your key material was extracted. As a precaution we can offer rewrap to vetted hardware and provide an audit package. Contact support@redwood.com to opt-in."
raj: Triage note: classify exploitability based on whether operator-level access is needed. If so, we'll need to enumerate operator entitlements and forensics.
kelly: Oncall checklist (logs): export wrap events and inspect attestation fields. Example cmd:
```
# GCP logs
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName=\"WrapKey\" AND resource.labels.cluster=\"hsm-prod-eu\"' --limit 200
# look at protoPayload.request.integrity.attestation
```
security-bot: BYOK incident runbook reminder: https://redwood-internal/security/incident-byok. Flag PCI/PHI if affected and loop Legal.
sanjay: Actions: @kelly run principal+wrap query and collect logs; @raj open RBAC PR to deny export+add JIT; @maria draft customer notification and loop Legal. I'll contact vendor.
kelly: Ran queries, DM'd Sanjay results. Found 2 principals with wrap+export in prod-eu. Logs uploaded to secure-share.
ops-bot: Incident #6150000015 set severity P2; triage in-progress.
maria: Warroom (30m) scheduled with Legal/Compliance and oncall. Invite out.
sanjay: KMS fallback note: prefer kms-proxy soft-wrap to avoid exporting raw key material. Raj — is this client-compatible?
raj: Yes. kms-proxy supports soft-wrap profiles and can proxy signing without exporting key bytes. I'll add compatibility notes in the RBAC PR.
sanjay: Keep updates here. If vendor confirms exploit we'll escalate to a full incident postmortem and update customers/SLA. :thumbsup:
